mapping.draft_py:
# Aggressive Mammoth: "Trample" (compiled keyword) + "Other creatures you control have trample."
# Shape: B4-grant-kw-static-you (Garruk's Uprising) with "other" = FNot(IS_SOURCE) (Bolt Hound).
other_trample = StaticAbility(effect=A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
    'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.TRAMPLE),
    'target': Selector(
        count=QUnbounded(),
        mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
        filter=FAnd(children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
            FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
        )),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
    ),
}))
abilities = [other_trample, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Other creatures you control have trample.

mapping.notes: B4-grant-kw-static-you shape with FNot(IS_SOURCE) for 'other'. Packs in mapper scratch: own other creature tramples over, opponent's creature does not.
